title: Run
$comment: v1.4. One execution of an approved plan (docs/api-contract.md: /runs).

plan_revision.description: The exact revision that was approved.

kind.description: task: a run of a newly approved plan, which stores a new workflow when verified. reverify: a replay of a stored workflow's steps (POST /workflows/{id}/reverify), which stores none. do_it: a stored verified workflow run for its owner with the owner's own values (POST /workflows/{id}/run); it never resets the site, pauses at every risky step and stores no workflow. sign_in: opens a site's sign-in page for its owner to sign in by hand in a takeover, then stores their session (POST /sites/{site}/sign-in, ADR 0007); no steps, no workflow.

source_workflow_id.description: reverify and do_it only: the stored workflow this run replays.

workflow_id.description: The workflow this run stored. Null until a task run is verified, and always null for a reverify or do_it run (see source_workflow_id).

takeover.description: The active takeover of this paused run's page (ADR 0008); null when nobody has control.

last_input_at.description: 5 min after this (or after started_at) without input, the takeover ends; the run stays paused.

RunHandBackRequest.title: RunHandBackRequest
RunHandBackRequest.description: POST /runs/{id}/handback: end the takeover and say what was done; Krama checks it and continues, or pauses again with the reason.

RunConfirmRequest.title: RunConfirmRequest
RunConfirmRequest.description: Resume a run paused on a destructive step.
